newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Far East Aluminium buys HK$35 mln property.
newsitem.headline: Far East Aluminium buys HK$35 mln property.

text.p: Fabrication and aluminium wall contractor Far East Aluminium (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it has agreed to buy an industrial building in Yuen Long in Hong Kong's New Territories for HK$35.70 million.
The company said the purchase would be funded by internal capital resources and bank financing.
The property, which comprise two building blocks covering a site area of 21,170 sq ft, is to be used as workshops and storage, a move to expand and improve production efficiency.
Its shares were untraded at HK$0.51 per share at midday.
